# Voice servers

Voice chat servers: TeamSpeak 3 and Mumble: 2 eggs.
Back to [all eggs](../README.md#voice-servers).

| Game | Egg | Runtime images | Extra ports | Tested | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mumble Server | [mumble.json](mumble.json) | [`debian`](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-yolks#debian) | – | [✓ 2026-10-12](../TESTED.md#voice-mumble) | no console input, start detected by port |
| TeamSpeak 3 Server | [teamspeak.json](teamspeak.json) | [`debian`](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-yolks#debian) | QUERY_PORT +1, FILE_TRANSFER_PORT +2 | [—](../TESTED.md#voice-teamspeak) | no console input, start detected by port |

Extra ports are the ports Octail assigns next to the primary one (`+1` = primary port + 1). Notes: RCON (and its protocol), the Players tab or a player count, idle sleep (wake on connect), Wine/Proton and other things to know.

Tested: the last real run of the egg on one of our nodes with the image it ships (install, ready line or bound port, a console command, stop): ✓ passed, ✗ failed, — not run on these images yet. Details in [TESTED.md](../TESTED.md).

## Importing this folder

```bash
octail egg:import https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/voice
```

Or in the panel: Admin → Eggs → Import eggs → **GitHub** with `https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/voice`. One
egg: its raw address, `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/main/voice/<egg>.json`.

Something wrong with one of these eggs? [Open an issue](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/issues/new/choose).
